    Skill icons
    Choose colorful Flaticon icons with your coding agent.
    View prompt
    Personalize my MySkills with colorful Flaticon icons.

Find my MySkills installation and its personal skill folders. Preserve skill instructions, names, categories, settings, and unrelated metadata. Leave system and plugin-managed skills unchanged. Preserve existing custom icons unless I approve replacing them.

Style and selection:
- Use Flaticon's Special Lineal color collection: simple shapes, thick black outlines, colorful fills, and consistent proportions. Match https://www.flaticon.com/free-icon/light-bulb_2988036 and prefer the same author/style family.
- Read each skill's purpose and choose a meaningful, distinctive icon. Inspect the actual PNG at dashboard size; a search result mentioning the style does not prove the icon uses it.
- Start with five representative skills and show their actual icons together, labeled with skill names and Flaticon source links. After I approve the direction, apply those choices and continue with the remaining personal skills.

Downloads and credits:
- Use PNGs with original colors and transparency, obtained through permitted official downloads under my own Flaticon license. Respect account access, download limits, and format restrictions. Do not bypass restrictions, purchase anything, or redistribute an icon bundle without authorization.
- Check each asset's current license and required attribution. Record its author, author URL, source URL, style, license, and download date. Retain any supplied license certificate. Keep the required footer credits small but readable.

Integration:
- Back up files before replacing them. Save each PNG as assets/flaticon.png inside its skill folder. Use PNGs no larger than 512 KB and 4096 by 4096 pixels.
- Preserve agents/openai.yaml and set icon_small and icon_large to "./assets/flaticon.png" inside its interface block, leaving other fields intact.
- Save assets/flaticon.credit.json with author, authorUrl, and sourceUrl as strings. Use HTTPS URLs for the author and the original Flaticon asset page. Include the additional provenance fields where practical. The dashboard reads this file to display attribution.
- Refresh the dashboard, verify every applied image loads and footer credits appear, and show me the result. No application code changes, rebuild, deployment, or service restart should be needed for these personal icon changes. Report anything left incomplete.

    Optional usage recording
    Ask Codex to run the launcher’s usage-instruction command and add its marked block to your global Codex instructions. Recording is best effort and stores timestamps only. The dashboard never edits those instructions automatically.
    

    GitHub backup
    Back up your personal skill folders and dashboard organization to a private repository in your own GitHub account. Linked personal skills are copied as ordinary folders. Built-in skills, plugin caches, nested links, usage logs and common credential files are excluded.
    Need help connecting?
    GitHub CLI is downloaded automatically if needed. If setup fails, copy this prompt into Codex, then try Connect GitHub again.
    Help me connect GitHub backup in MySkills. Check whether the official GitHub CLI (gh) is installed and available to the dashboard. If it is missing, install it for my operating system from the official GitHub CLI distribution at https://cli.github.com/. Help me sign in to GitHub using its browser or device-code flow, then guide me back to Settings → Manage GitHub backup → Connect GitHub. Keep credentials in GitHub CLI's authentication management; never paste tokens or device codes into this chat. Do not create a repository, upload skills, or enable backups until I request it.
